title: myrcianthes fragrans var. simpsonii
intro: Myrcianthes fragrans var. simpsonii, commonly known as the 'Hilo Silversword', is a plant species belonging to the Myrtaceae family. The Hilo Silversword has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can help in treating wounds, reducing oxidative stress, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of the Hilo Silversword include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
